div.l: I wyl my self goodly wyth you ryde
Ryght at myn owen cost and be your gyde
And who that wol my Iugement wyth say
Shortly shal paye al that is spent by the way
And yf ye vouchesauf that it be soo
Tel me anone wythoute wordys moo
And I wyl erly shape me therfore
Thys thyng was graunted and othis swore
Wyth ful glad herte ⁊and preyen hym also
That he wold vouchesauf that it be so
And that he wolde be our gouernour
And of oure talis Iuge and reportour
And sette a souper at a certayn pryce
And wold be rewlid at hys deuyce
Hygh and lowe and alle by on assent
We be accorded to hys Iugement
And there vp on the wyne was fet anone
We dronk and to reste went we echone
Wyth oute eny lenger taryynge
Amorow whan the day gan sprynge
Vp roos our host and was al onr cok
And gadred vs to gydre alle in a flok
And forth we ryden lityl more than paas
Vnto the waterynge of saynt Thomas
And there our oste gan hys hors areste
And sayde harkeneth lordyngz yf ye lyste
Ye woot our forward and I you recorde
Yf euensong and morow song acorde
Let se now who shal telle the fyrste tale
As euyr moot I drynke wyne or ale
Who so wyl be rebel to my Iugement
Shal paye for al that is by the way spent
NOw draw cut or that ye further twynne
Whyche shal the fyrst tale begynne
Syre knyght quod he my mayster ⁊and my lord
Now drawyth cut for that is myn accord
Cometh hythyr quod he my lady Pryoresse
And ye sire clerk let by your shamefastnesse
